newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks flat in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks flat in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks stayed flat in early Friday morning trade as investors were reluctant to hold postitions over the three-day weekend, brokers said.
Market players also feel that the key Nikkei average may be ready for a pause after its recent winning streak, they said.
Markets will be closed on Monday for a holiday.

After 21 minutes of trade, the Nikkei 225 was up 21.60 points or 0.11 percent at 19,296.93. Its June futures were up 30 points at 19,330. "In the very near term a correction may occur but pension funds should keep buying so the weak spell will probably be short-lived," one broker said.
